name: figma-pilot-mcp
description: An MCP server that gives AI full control over Figma — read, create, and modify designs.

scripts.build: bunx esbuild src/plugin/code.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/plugin/code.js --target=es2018 --format=iife && cp src/plugin/manifest.json src/plugin/ui.html dist/plugin/
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p src/plugin/tsconfig.json && biome check src

author: chicunic
